implementationNotes: Do not treat estimated values as recovered original map data.
Keep balance data separate from Phaser scene logic.
Do not invent the remaining original abilities or the 49 combinations; add them only when a source or tested design is available.
Tune one mechanic at a time using repeatable arena tests.
